# QA and Acceptance Checklist — CyberDJs.org

## Visual identity

- [ ] Site feels like CyberDJs, not a template
- [ ] Dark/cyber/rave/lab direction is coherent
- [ ] Motion supports the music concept
- [ ] No generic fake-cyberpunk filler

## Homepage

- [ ] Hero loads correctly
- [ ] Booking CTA visible early
- [ ] Crew section works
- [ ] Music section works
- [ ] Events section works
- [ ] Projects/lab section works
- [ ] Manifesto section works
- [ ] Footer works

## Responsive

- [ ] Mobile portrait
- [ ] Mobile landscape
- [ ] Tablet
- [ ] Laptop
- [ ] Desktop
- [ ] Large display

## Navigation

- [ ] Main nav works
- [ ] Mobile nav works
- [ ] Footer links work
- [ ] CTA links work
- [ ] No broken internal links
- [ ] External links open as intended

## Booking

- [ ] Booking page/section reachable
- [ ] Fields labeled
- [ ] Validation works
- [ ] Success state works
- [ ] Error state works
- [ ] Spam protection considered
- [ ] Email/fallback destination verified
- [ ] No private data leaks

## Accessibility

- [ ] Keyboard navigation works
- [ ] Focus states visible
- [ ] Heading order logical
- [ ] Forms have labels
- [ ] Images have alt text or are decorative
- [ ] Contrast acceptable
- [ ] Reduced motion respected
- [ ] No keyboard traps

## SEO and social

- [ ] Title tags
- [ ] Meta descriptions
- [ ] Canonical URLs
- [ ] OpenGraph tags
- [ ] Social preview image
- [ ] Favicon
- [ ] Sitemap
- [ ] Robots.txt
- [ ] Structured data where applicable

## Performance

- [ ] Images optimized
- [ ] Heavy embeds lazy-loaded
- [ ] Fonts optimized
- [ ] JavaScript payload reasonable
- [ ] No major layout shifts
- [ ] Animations do not stutter
- [ ] Lighthouse checked

## Security

- [ ] No secrets committed
- [ ] `.env` ignored
- [ ] Dependency audit reviewed if available
- [ ] External scripts justified
- [ ] Form validation exists
- [ ] No sensitive logs
- [ ] Headers reviewed where possible

## Production

- [ ] `https://cyberdjs.org` loads
- [ ] HTTPS works
- [ ] Redirects sane
- [ ] Production assets load
- [ ] Production booking works
- [ ] Production console checked
- [ ] Production network checked
- [ ] GitHub Actions/deploy status checked
- [ ] Final report written
